messages:
alice: Heads-up for tonight's 02:00 UTC change window: planning to deploy API 2.14.0, Runtime 3.7.2, Console v2026.03.02 (hotfix), and Router header-split 1.12.5. Need pins, a deploybot wave, and rollback criteria. Any blockers?
ben: Runtime has two small fixes. I'll pin runtime->3.7.2 and run a short staging canary. No migrations from my side.
carla: Console hotfix ready. Release notes draft: https://redwood/release-notes/console-v2026.03.02-draft. Note: console relies on API /session field introduced in 2.14-rc2. If we revert API to 2.13, console will throw schema errors.
dinesh: Router header-split plan: enable `x-rw-experimental` only on canary slices. Traffic plan: 5% -> 25% -> manual 100% ramp. Will drain kv cache TTL on canary nodes. Rollback = flip header flag off and reprovision stable tag.
ben: @deploybot please create wave with sequence: router -> runtime -> api -> console. 5min observation at each step, then manual approval. Also keep 2.13 pinned in fallback pool.
deploybot: Wave created: 1717660123-rc1. Sequence: router, runtime, api, console. Canary slices: 5% then 25%. Observers: @oncall-eve. Cancel command: `/deploy cancel 1717660123-rc1`.
oncall-eve: I'll be primary oncall. Telemetry to watch: p50 latency, p95 latency, 5xx rate, API schema errors, kv-cache miss rate. Trigger rollback if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > +30% sustained for 10m.
carla: Add a schema guard: if /session schema validation fails in canary (even a single failure) block rollout.
ben: Noted. Runtime will use `runtime.kv_evict_threshold=0.6` for canary to reduce eviction spikes we saw in staging with header split. Also will add a warmup step.
dinesh: Router quick-rollback path: flip `x-rw-experimental` off and route traffic back to `router:tag=stable`. That should be a fast revert without touching runtime/API pins.
alice: I will add a "compatibility" note to release docs calling out console dependency on /session and router header behavior. Draft release notes: https://redwood/release-notes/2.14.0-draft
oncall-eve: Please embed Grafana links and paste runbook snippets (queries, thresholds, mitigation steps). I'll attach the runbook in the release notes before deploy.
carla: DB migrations? Confirmed none for this release.
ben: Pushing pins now: runtime=3.7.2, api=2.14.0, console=v2026.03.02, router=1.12.5-header-split
deploybot: Pins applied. Wave 1717660123-rc1 scheduled. Channel will receive step updates during rollout.
alice: Thanks everyone. If anything anomalous comes up ping me or @oncall-eve. Proceed with the scheduled window. :rocket:
